mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.status, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.category_id, c.name as category_name, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN blog_tags bt ON b.id = bt.blog_id WHERE b.status = 1 AND bt.tag_id = #{tagId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.status, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.category_id, c.name as category_name, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.view_count DESC, b.like_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.status, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.category_id, c.name as category_name, b.created_at, b.updated_at, COUNT(bv.id) as period_views FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN blog_views bv ON b.id = bv.blog_id WHERE b.status = 1 AND bv.viewed_at >= NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::INTERVAL GROUP BY b.id, u.username, u.avatar_url, c.name ORDER BY period_views DESC LIMIT #{limit}
